text: 等你恢复自我时，数年已经过去。你成了温尼伯一家精神病院的病人；当年一位传教士在一处偏远社群中发现你，那些人把你当作神圣的疯人，此后你便一直住在那里。
记忆恢复后，你很快康复。你回到阿卡姆，试图重新拾起生活。由于长期被认定已经死亡，你在密斯卡托尼克大学的职位早已由他人接替。遗产也已分给继承人；经过诉讼，你才追回其中一部分。
随着时间推移，夜间的恐惧逐渐消退，但你只能找到二流教职。你的讲课因时常说到一半便停下、凝望虚空而声名狼藉。你发表了北汉尼纳之行的记述，但既无文件也无实物证据，加上你曾精神失常的经历，除了少数古怪的神秘学圈子，无人相信你。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 549
text: When you are next yourself, years have passed. An inmate in a Winnipeg asylum, you have lived there since being found by a missionary, living with a remote community of people as a sacred Mad One.

With the recovery of your memory, you rapidly recuperate. You return to Arkham and try to pick up the threads of your life. As you were long presumed dead, your position at Miskatonic University has been filled. Your estate has been apportioned among your heirs; only litigation restores a portion of what was yours.

With time, the night fears diminish, but you can secure only second-rate teaching jobs and your lectures become notorious for occasional interruptions where you tail off, staring into space. You publish your account of the North Hanninah trip but, without documentation or physical evidence, and with your history of insanity, you convince no one except an eccentric occult fringe group.
